name: Gujarat Craft Industries Limited
about: Gujarat Craft Industries Limited manufactures, imports, and exports plastic packing materials in India and internationally. The company offers tarpaulins, waterproof tarpaulins, FIBC bags, woven sacks, jumbo bags, HDPE pipes, packaging FIBC bags, vermi beds, PP woven sacks, pond liners, HDPE geomembranes, PP bags, woven fabric rolls, HDPE tarpaulins, blue tarpaulin sheets, BOPP bags, truck tarpaulins, jumbo asbestos bags, tarpaulin covers, PP super sacks, agricultural pond liners, plastic granules, HDPE geomembrane liner sheets, jumbo bags, waterproofing membranes, baffle bags, woven fabrics, and geosynthetics. It also provides geomembrane sheets, monsoon sheds, OFDA tarpaulins, laminated tarpaulins, lay flat tubing products, waist bags, HDPE bags, agricultural HDPE pipes, LDPE liner bags, BOPP laminated bags, laminated woven sacks, fertilizer bags, truck covers, and PP sugar bags. In addition, the company offers after-sales services. It serves the agriculture, fertilizer, cement, and food grain industries. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Gandhinagar, India.
